candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier from transferOwnership, allowing anyone to call it and change the owner.
Change the require condition to always pass, allowing any caller to execute guarded functions including transferOwnership.
Delete the require statement inside onlyOwner, making the modifier always allow execution, so anyone can call transferOwnership.
Assign a constant address instead of the parameter, so the owner becomes a fixed address instead of newOwner.
Assign msg.sender instead of newOwner, so ownership transfers to the caller rather than the intended new owner.
Delete the onlyOwner modifier from the owned() function definition.
Delete the require statement from the onlyOwner modifier.
Insert a statement that sets owner to address(0) before the underscore.
Replace `owner = newOwner;` with `owner = address(0);` so ownership is set to zero address instead of the given new owner.
Replace `require(msg.sender == owner);` with `require(msg.sender != owner);` so only non-owners can call protected functions, breaking ownership transfer.
Delete the `onlyOwner` modifier from `transferOwnership` so anyone can change the owner, not just the current owner.
